pages.summary:
- Gourav Vani is a final‑year B.Tech student in AI/ML (CGPA 9.4) with internships at Scaler Technologies and CodSoft, where he built high‑accuracy NLP and ensemble models for resume screening, churn prediction, fraud/spam detection, and sentiment analysis, and created dashboards and APIs for real‑time monitoring.  
- He has delivered production projects such as an AI Legal Assistant (RAG system with FAISS/LangChain) and a loan‑approval risk dashboard (Random Forest with SHAP), and possesses strong skills in Python, ML frameworks, MLOps, data visualization, and generative AI, complemented by certifications from Deloitte, Accenture, and AWS simulations.

GOURAV VANI 
Machine Learning Engineer  |  AI/ML Final Year Student 
+91-9644575202  •  linkedin.com/in/gourav-vani-a648b0375  •  github.com/gouravvani267  •  Indore, India 
 
EDUCATION 
B.Tech — Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning  |  IPS Academy, Indore Aug 2023 – May 2027 
CGPA: 9.4 / 10.0  •  Coursework: ML, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, Data Structures & Algorithms, Statistics 
EXPERIENCE 
Machine Learning Intern  |  Scaler Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Feb 2026 – Apr 2026 
• Automated resume screening for 1,000+ job postings by 70% via an end-to-end ATS pipeline using NLP, Scikit-learn, and REST API endpoints; 
achieved 92% keyword-matching accuracy across 5,000–8,000 resumes. 
• Boosted churn recall by 18% on 50K+ customer records training Random Forest and XGBoost ensembles with SMOTE oversampling; final model 
reached 91.4% prediction accuracy. 
• Reduced stakeholder reporting time by 60% building Power BI / Tableau dashboards backed by Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn) 
for real-time ML model monitoring. 
• Cut text preprocessing time by 35% on a 25K+ review corpus implementing TF-IDF + Logistic Regression and Naive Bayes; achieved 88% 
sentiment classification accuracy. 
Machine Learning Intern  |  CodSoft Dec 2025 – Jan 2026 
• Achieved 99.2% fraud detection accuracy and 94% recall on 284K+ transactions using XGBoost + Random Forest with SMOTE; inference served 
via REST API at sub-10ms latency. 
• Delivered 98.6% spam detection accuracy at under 2ms latency on 5,500+ messages with Naive Bayes + SVM ensemble; containerized using 
Docker for reproducible deployment. 
• Reached 82% macro F1 across 20 genres on 27K+ movie plots with multi-label TF-IDF + Logistic Regression, threshold-tuning, and stratified 
cross-validation. 
PROJECTS 
AI Legal Assistant  |  Python, FastAPI, RAG, FAISS, LangChain, React  |  live website 
• Deployed a production RAG system over the Indian legal corpus (10,000+ clauses) that cut query resolution time ~70% vs. manual research and 
reduced hallucinations by 60% via citation grounding and multi-turn context architecture. 
NexusBank — Loan Approval System  |  Scikit-learn, SHAP, React, REST API, Vercel 
• Built a Random Forest classifier at 91% approval accuracy with a real-time risk dashboard at under 500ms latency; SHAP values surface the top 
5 risk factors per application for loan officers. 
Handwritten Text Generation  |  LSTM, TensorFlow, Keras, IAM Dataset  |  GitHub 
• Reduced LSTM training loss by 35% on the IAM dataset using gradient clipping and LR scheduling over 50 epochs. 
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
Languages: Python, SQL, C++

Seaborn 
ML Techniques: Classification, Regression, Clustering, NLP, RAG, LSTM, CNN, Ensemble Methods, SMOTE, SHAP, FAISS, Feature Engineering, EDA,
